title: Keep a measured width under the same layout it was measured in
rule: When the UI measures an element's on-screen size to store it (lock a width, remember a column, pin a panel), the layout that later applies the stored value must use the same tracks, gaps and padding as the layout it was measured in. Do not add or remove a grid column, gap or margin between the measuring state and the applying state. Floor the measured value so rounding never makes it too big to fit. Add a Playwright check that toggles the state at an unchanged viewport and asserts the element keeps its width within 1 px.
rationale: E12.4 (#107): the badge rows used `5em minmax(0, 1fr)` while unlocked but `5em minmax(0, W) 5em` once locked, so locking at the same window size shrank the text about 73 px and the text reflowed; the e2e check only measured after resizes.
